title: Credential Scope Requirement
description: Requires that credentials are sent only to the configured origin of the service they belong to, never to a URL taken from response data that names another origin.

allowed-origin.description: The setting whose scheme, host and port define the only origin that receives the credentials.

on-mismatch.description: What happens to a request whose URL names another origin.

enforced.description: Whether the origin check always runs before credentials are sent.
